title: Tenancy
summary: TEN'ANCY, noun [Latin tenens.] In law, a holding or possession of lands or tenements; tenure; as tenancy in fee simple; tenancy in tail; tenancy by the curtesy; tenancy at will. tenancy in common happ

inlines.v: TEN'ANCY, noun [Latin tenens.] In law, a holding or possession of lands or tenements; tenure; as tenancy in fee simple; tenancy in tail; tenancy by the curtesy; tenancy at will. tenancy in common happens where there is a unity of possession merely.
